synopsis: TNO, based in the Netherlands, provides scenario-based testing, with the available evidence mostly concerning road applications [f16117, f8829]. Its reported capabilities also include virtual validation, vehicle dynamics and ADAS evaluation [f8829]. TNO collaborates with AVL and the Keysight, IPG and ESTECO chain; a demonstration with the latter three combined scenario simulation, CarMaker vehicle simulation, HIL radar emulation and probabilistic analysis [f8830, f8711]. These facts establish road-automotive capabilities and collaboration, but do not establish heavy off-road validation experience [f16117, f8829, f8830].

relations.note: Adds virtual validation, vehicle dynamics and ADAS evaluation to the glossary's scenario-testing description.
The joint demonstration evidences collaboration with Keysight, IPG and ESTECO.
The demonstration provides a concrete example of TNO's involvement in virtual-validation workflows.
